name: El Niño / La Niña
summary: Super El Niño: Oceanic Niño Index +2.46°C for Aug–Oct
state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for August–October was +2.46°C, far above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event (NOAA CPC). Strong El Niños usually peak in northern winter; forecasters warn of drought and lower harvests in southern Africa (CITE).
for_you: El Niño shifts rainfall worldwide; follow your national met service for seasonal outlooks.

sources.title: CITE — Super El Niño threatens southern Africa with drought and crop failures

why: ENSO reshapes global weather for a year at a time — droughts, floods, hurricanes and crop yields.
drivers: Pacific trade winds and ocean heat content.
